name: Tome of Divinity
summary: In Ironforge, young dwarven paladins are sent to Tiza Battleforge to learn the Holy Light's deeper duties. Their rite of passage reaches beyond martial training and toward sacred vows.

sections.title: The Call to the High Seat
sections.body: You have defended Anvilmar and Kharanos from troggs and frost trolls, proving your discipline in battle. Now Brandur Ironhammer, your trainer, sends you upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries. Senior paladins there prepare initiates for the order's spiritual duties.

sections.title: Guidance from Tiza Battleforge
sections.body: Tiza Battleforge teaches that the Light asks more than swordplay and hammer blows. It asks for compassion, justice, and self-sacrifice. Seeking her begins your formal study of the Tome of Divinity, a sacred path toward the power to resurrect the fallen.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Brandur Ironhammer sends young dwarven paladins from their trainer to senior paladin Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge. This begins the trials for studying the Tome of Divinity and gaining the power of spiritual resurrection.

Brandur Ironhammer trains dwarven paladins in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge's Mystic Ward. He watches over young paladins and sends promising initiates upstairs to Tiza Battleforge when they are ready for greater sacred duties.
Tiza Battleforge is a respected veteran paladin upstairs in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She teaches younger paladins what the Holy Light demands beyond martial skill.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead next?
faq.answer: Speaking with Tiza Battleforge begins the Tome of Divinity trials. They test a paladin's devotion, mercy, and willingness to protect and restore life in service to the Light.

faq.q: Why must dwarven paladins seek out the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: A paladin must learn selflessness and spiritual duty to return a fallen ally to life. The Tome of Divinity guides initiates through formal lessons and tests of faith needed to channel such potent holy power.

faq.q: Do humans receive this same instruction in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Human paladins follow a parallel path through the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. Brandur Ironhammer's summons to Tiza Battleforge is for dwarves training in Ironforge.

angles.text: As a paladin, you move from martial drills toward the spiritual duties of the Holy Light. The trials lead toward the power of Redemption.
As a dwarf, you join devotion to the Holy Light with Khaz Modan's traditions of duty and brotherhood. You answer the call in Ironforge's mountain halls.
